notes.title: Demo update v0.9.3
notes.content:
- Translations added to support 27 languages.
- Most of the UI redone with a new look.
- Removed level restrictions on tower building.
- Various bug fixes

tags.feature: - Translations added to support 27 languages.
- Most of the UI redone with a new look.

tags.balance_change: - Removed level restrictions on tower building.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.8.1
notes.content:
- Saving system rewritten from the ground up. This unfortunately means the previous progress won't be carried over.
- Settings page updated. More graphics settings included to accomodate wider range of hardware if performance is an issue.
- Camera controller completelly rewritten from the ground up and input system updated.
- A lot of the codebase has been rewritten in the background, which for the end-user should function as before. This is just in preparation for the full version release.

tags.feature: - Saving system rewritten from the ground up.
- Settings page updated. More graphics settings included to accomodate wider range of hardware if performance is an issue.
- Camera controller completelly rewritten from the ground up and input system updated.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.5.0
notes.content:
[h3]Cloud Save[/h3]
All your progress should be synced and backed up in the Steam Cloud.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/f7a55515e13f664eebd959377b3fc1996be5ae32.png[/img]

[h3]UI improvements[/h3]
Tower selection and in-game upgrades list panels include scrolling

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/1877a3c4eac0084f58b0156d314829feb6d87645.png[/img]

The sizing of projectile description and upgrade description windows are now dymanic.

And other small UI fixes.

tags.feature: All your progress should be synced and backed up in the Steam Cloud.
Tower selection and in-game upgrades list panels include scrolling
The sizing of projectile description and upgrade description windows are now dymanic.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.2
notes.content:
[h3]New power up: +50 coins when a tile is explored.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/49e57f184950a4bbbaf8715bbce9780f03f569a0.png[/img]

[h3]New tower: Tar[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/5661ce812eb8706247ff2a4628ddf1c3bc79a324.png[/img]

Tar tower has low AoE damage, but two effects which slow down enemies and add fire weakness to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/b1dc56d9ab3aeb308761dc82bacb731a86a999fe.png[/img]

[h3]Sound system improvements[/h3]

* Sounds added to menu buttons.
* Fixed cases where sounds would stop playing when many of them were triggered consecutivelly.

[h3]Game balance adjustments[/h3]

First 10 tile rounds rebalanced. Some enemies have less health and give more rewards.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]New features and improvements[/h2]

Added Wood Tower which shoots Acorns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/8f0d10cb1e93fc3259f34c24124bcca7fe3b9587.png[/img]


Added "Sidekick" power up to meta progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/0147e8989855b8d2b08703c06686ca34a253137c.png[/img]


When you have a tower selected, you can now deselect it with both Left Click and Right Click, whereas previously it was only possible with Right Click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/dbf955d6b791fe4ba303ac979595b60b129a003f.png[/img]


Increased the font size on various menus to make the text legible for more screen sizes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/dbd7213aa21bbf8c3cb7652dd2443da6c40a6751.png[/img]


Added Critical Hit indicator, which shows for a fraction of a second when critical hit happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/a168b7fd7ee96b83bf93f68e51520d86c1386f83.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay adjustments[/h2]

[list]
[*] Earth Tower costs more and rate of fire is reduced
[*] Increased meta coins earning by about x2.5
[*] Small adjustments to the starting enemy waves
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]New features/content[/h2]

Added Poison Tower which does area damage around the tower. It also applies poison effect on enemies.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/7edac5eec4aa094462225c95ace22a3fbd565bd6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/7edac5eec4aa094462225c95ace22a3fbd565bd6.png[/img][/url]


Meta Progression system implemented with currently 2 power ups (more to come in future updates). Meta coins will be rewarded at the end of each run.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/f97aac76ca042a50583208f2f07509baa683898c.png]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/f97aac76ca042a50583208f2f07509baa683898c.png[/img][/url]


Statistics added at the end of a run show tower and effect damage. This applies to per-tower effects and global effects that do damage too.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/a4697168bd13fbdbd2826623ee2e6c83a1ed947b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/a4697168bd13fbdbd2826623ee2e6c83a1ed947b.png[/img][/url]


+1 new Upgrade added - Crowbar.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/0f4accca32ad8efcd02a47936a9f436c969f7211.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575635/0f4accca32ad8efcd02a47936a9f436c969f7211.png[/img][/url]


[h2]Bug fixes/small changes[/h2]

- Blood Scent upgrade's critical chance bonus was previously ignored. This is taken into account now.
- Wind Tower renamed to Ice Tower
- Add mouse controls visuals in Esc menu
- Some spelling mistakes in scroll descriptions
